informationPolicy.rule: The player-facing snapshot exposes reports and declared operational data, not every field in the true world state.

observations.label: Weekly operations summary

observations.revisionModel: A designed event revises one region's return during the run.

observations.label: Domestic crop estimate
observations.revisionModel: At the declared crop-revision turn, the estimate is replaced using the seeded crop multiplier.

observations.label: Port engineering assessment
